F002 is implemented as `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/doc_drift.py` plus `tests/test_doc_drift_guard_f002.py` (both staged; the module carries refinements from auditor iterations i0–i4). The pure helper `registered_worker_names()` returns `sorted(AGENT_REGISTRY)` as the source of truth, and `scan_allowlisted_docs()` scans the fixed allowlist (`README.md`, `docs/AGENT_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md` — the latter skipped until F003 lands it) for units that assert a non-registry watched agent (canonical runtime universe plus `ollama`) as a shipped executor, with per-agent, segment-scoped disclaimer attribution so one agent's "operator-only" annotation cannot excuse another agent's claim. The targeted test run passed all 28 cases: the guard fails on the pre-F001 README checklist line and on bare "Gemini is a shipped executor" prose (plus ten auditor bypass probes across separator types, status-disclaimer suppression, and contradiction orderings), passes on the post-F001 corrected phrasing, relaxes automatically when `gemini` is added to the registered set, and the acceptance case confirms the live repo docs scan clean against the live registry. No side-effect commands were run beyond the read-only pytest invocation above.
